name: openai-python

finish.primary: Chat: choices[0].finish_reason, including error.completion.choices[0].finish_reason. Responses: incomplete_details.reason, otherwise status; completed with an output function_call maps to tool_calls, completed with a refusal content part maps to refusal. Raw retains the reason or status string.

text.primary: Chat: choices[0].message.content; streams join choices[0].delta.content. Responses: output_text; streams join response.output_text.delta.delta. LengthFinishReasonError.completion retains message content.

structured.primary: Chat parse: choices[0].message.parsed. Responses parse: output_parsed. Pydantic values serialize with model_dump(mode="json").

tool_calls.primary: Chat: choices[0].message.tool_calls[].id and function.name/arguments; streams concatenate choices[0].delta.tool_calls by index. Responses: output function_call.call_id/name/arguments; streams read response.output_item.done.item and terminal response.output. Arguments are parsed with json.loads only.

usage.primary: Chat: usage.prompt_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, completion_tokens, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, total_tokens, including LengthFinishReasonError.completion. Responses: usage.input_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, output_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens, total_tokens. Stream chunks/events use the same fields.

stream.primary: Count each SDK yield. Chat create streams expose no completion sentinel; completed stays null. Responses response.completed/response.incomplete are terminal events; response.failed and typed error events report failure. Raised errors set completed=false.

config_notes: API key and base_url point the default synchronous OpenAI client at replay. SDK retry, timeout and response-validation defaults are unchanged; the shim performs no retries.

max_output_tokens maps to max_completion_tokens for openai-chat, max_tokens for ollama-openai, and max_output_tokens for openai-responses. The SDK sends whichever field the caller passes, so request.max-tokens-field and request.max-tokens-ollama-openai grade this choice: max_completion_tokens because the SDK marks max_tokens deprecated in its favor, max_tokens because Ollama's OpenAI compatibility page lists only that field.
Structured calls build Pydantic types from the supplied schema: required object properties, additionalProperties=false, arrays and strings. Other schema features stop the shim as unmapped.
Responses stop sequences and streamed structured output are not mapped because no supported-provider cell uses them. No graded call fields are omitted.
